newsitem.title: UK: Bookmaker cuts odds on British election in March.
newsitem.headline: Bookmaker cuts odds on British election in March.

text.p: Bookmakers William Hill said on Thursday it had cut its odds on a British election being held in March to 6-4 from 11-4, although it said May was still favourite at 8-11.
"We've seen a flurry of bets for March today," William Hill said in a news release.
An April election was the outside bet with odds of 4-1.
The opposition Labour Party is favourite to win the election, which must be held by May 22, at 1-4, the bookmakers said.
The ruling Conservatives, which lag Labour by around 20 points in opinion polls, are at 5-2.
